summary: Mixed day dominated by retail sector momentum and Reliance developments. India's apparel market projected to reach $146B by 2029 with 9% CAGR, while Jio Platforms IPO launch imminent on October 21.

bullets.text: India apparel market set to grow from $95.7B in 2025 to $146.3B by 2029 at 9% CAGR, driven by rural and smaller-town consumption.
Jio Platforms plans October 21 IPO launch, per sources; Reliance pursuing major capital market move.
US 30-year fixed mortgage rate surged to 7.40%, driven by rising inflation and elevated Treasury yields, likely eroding housing demand.
Delhi High Court ruled furnishing fake caste certificate alone insufficient grounds to remove lawyer from advocate rolls; requires additional misconduct findings.
US suspended major outsourcing firms including Infosys, Tata, Wipro, HCL from PERM permanent labour certification programme; employees transitioning from H-1B to residency relatively limited.
